Nina (Presales): Need a 1-page POC runbook for a demo tomorrow: streaming SDK examples (Node + Go), function/tool-call pattern, structured JSON output schema example, ephemeral creds handshake cURL, and a short security QA (KMS, log retention, SOC2 link). Can someone draft a compact cheat by EOD?

Lee (Eng): Ill draft. Confirm hosted EU region, ephemeral tokens required, and fallback to quantized model for cost spikes? Also: what's their peak QPS target?

Sam (Sales): Hosted EU yes. Peak ~2k QPS steady, bursts to ~5k. 99p target ~150ms. Logs must be off by default; legal wants KMS details. Finance will fill pricing placeholders.

Lee (Eng): Draft notes (compact):
- Goal: demo streaming chat + function/tool calls + structured output validation.
- Env: hosted eu, model r-infer-2 (fallback: r-infer-2-quant-small).
- Auth: API key or short-lived token; example token exchange: `curl -X POST https://auth.redwood.ai/token -d \"client_id=...\"`
- Node snippet (stream + function call): `const c=new Redwood({apiKey:process.env.RW_KEY});const s=c.chat.stream({model:'r-infer-2',region:'eu'});s.on('event',e=>{if(e.type==='function_call')fetch('https://hooks.app/call',{method:'POST',body:JSON.stringify(e.payload)});if(e.type==='message')console.log(e.message)});`
- Go snippet (stream receive): `cli:=redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv(\"RW_KEY\"));stream:=cli.ChatStream(ctx,redwood.ChatParams{Model:\"r-infer-2\"});for ev := range stream.Events(){ if ev.Type==redwood.EventFunctionCall{http.Post(\"https://hooks.app/call\",\"application/json\",bytes.NewReader(ev.Payload))}}`
- Structured output: validate against JSON Schema on receive, e.g. `{"type":"object","properties":{"intent":{"type":"string"},"items":{"type":"array"}}}`; recommend SDK schema hook.
- Handshake cURL (SSE): `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY\" -H \"Accept: text/event-stream\" \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/streams/chat?model=r-infer-2&region=eu\"`
- Operational knobs: batching window 10-20ms, KV prefix caching enabled, quantized fallback when queue >75% or 99p latency >80ms.
- Pricing: provide two options (reserved capacity + burst bucket) or pay-as-you-go (placeholders to be filled by finance).
- Security bullets: EU-only endpoints; TLS in transit; KMS-managed keys at rest (HSM optional); logs off by default, retention configurable; SOC2 attestation & DPA link (legal to add).
- Troubleshooting quick hits: 401 -> check token/KMS rotation & clock skew; SSE stalls -> missing Accept header/CORS; tool calls failing -> webhook TLS or IP allowlist.

Nina (Presales): This is perfect. I'll paste into the customer-facing one-pager and ask finance/legal to update placeholders. Tag me when SOC2 link is added.
